newsitem.title: USA: Scios, Wyeth-Ayerst start Phase II trial.
newsitem.headline: Scios, Wyeth-Ayerst start Phase II trial.

text.p: Scios Inc and Wyeth-Ayerst, the pharmaceutical division of American Home Products Corp, said on Monday they have started a Phase II clinical trial of the Scios drug, Fiblast trafermin.

Fiblast is a form of human basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) that in preclinical tests has shown the ability to improve blood flow to human limbs. It will be tested in patients with peripheral vascular disease who suffer from intermittent claudication, or pain when exercising.
The double-blind, placebo-controlled study will determine the safety and efficacy of intravenously-delivered Fiblast.
